tutorials.heading: Getting started
tutorials.intro: New here? These short video tutorials walk through the app's features — from reading and searching the Bible to notes, tags, and audio. Watch them in order or jump straight to the feature you need.
tutorials.empty: Tutorials are being recorded — check back soon.

tour-of-the-app.title: Tour of the app
tour-of-the-app.description: Get oriented: the top bar, the bottom bar, auto-hiding chrome, and the main menu.

go-to-any-verse.title: Go to any verse
go-to-any-verse.description: Navigate by book, chapter, and verse using the passage picker, the arrow buttons, and swipe.

book-outline-section-headings.title: Book outline via section headings
book-outline-section-headings.description: Jump around a book by tapping a section heading to open the chapter outline.

select-and-share-verses.title: Select verses and share them
select-and-share-verses.description: Tap verses to select them, then share the passage or open it on external study sites from the action toolbar.

switch-bible-translation.title: Switch Bible translation
switch-bible-translation.description: Pick a translation and see how text and audio options are chosen independently.

listen-to-a-chapter.title: Listen to a chapter
listen-to-a-chapter.description: Play chapter audio and use the player bar to pause, seek, and follow along.

audio-playlists.title: Audio playlists
audio-playlists.description: Keep listening beyond one chapter with continuous playlist playback.

search-the-bible.title: Search the Bible
search-the-bible.description: Full-text search across the active translation, plus the / keyboard shortcut.

create-an-account.title: Create an account and sign in
create-an-account.description: Register, log in and out, and see which features an account unlocks.

take-a-note-on-verses.title: Take a note on verses
take-a-note-on-verses.description: Attach a note to selected verses straight from the action toolbar.

the-note-editor.title: The note editor
the-note-editor.description: Everything inside the rich-text note form: formatting, images, and saving.

browse-and-organize-notes.title: Browse and organize your notes
browse-and-organize-notes.description: Find, reorder, and arrange notes on the notes page.

tags-organize-and-share.title: Tags: organize notes and share them
tags-organize-and-share.description: Use Tag Management to group notes and make a tag publicly shareable.

share-a-note-or-tag.title: Share a note or a tag
share-a-note-or-tag.description: Send a public link to a single note or a whole tag.

comments-on-notes.title: Comments on notes
comments-on-notes.description: Discuss public notes in comment threads.

reading-position-follows-you.title: Your reading position follows you
reading-position-follows-you.description: Each book remembers where you left off and resumes there.

extras.title: Extras: dark mode, problem reports, Android app
extras.description: The remaining menu items: the theme switch, reporting a problem, and the Android app.
